name: Ballistic Max — Single Stage Peak Performance
description: Best possible single-stage rocket on the O8000 (41 kNs class O). Maximize apogee and Mach number with full v4 realism: shouldered nose/interstage, min-diameter motor fit enforced (161mm motor in 87mm OD airframe), per-stage recovery train, structural masses. No multi-stage complexity — a pure ballistic performance baseline. No Rust Stage 1 (engine is 3-stage-only); run Stage 2 only with a generous GA. Target: highest apogee a single O8000 can reach.

seeds._comment: OR-validated champion — 15.28 km / Mach 3.12, +1.59 cal margin (2026-07-02)
